task.title: Met wants can't be edited from collection tables
task.description: Follow-up to WB-01M0DSYZDJ (WANTED stepper in collection tables). A want that is exactly met (desired == present) collapses to '—' in the WANTED cell per the app-ui.md 'WANTED only when set and different' rule, so it cannot be stepped from the table — the user must go to the card detail page. Relaxing the collapse rule (e.g. show the steppable count whenever a desires row exists) is a maintainer call on spec'd behavior. Reachable through the shipped UI; low urgency. Filed from adversarial review of task/my-cards-want-stepper.
